Kuvitus: talvinen yhteistuotantovoimalai: Illustration: a combined heat and power plant in winter. Steam rises from the chimney and the plant, power lines carry electricity away, and district heating pipes run to the city: the red flow pipe carries hot water and the blue return pipe carries cooled water. The windows of the apartment buildings glow warm.
Kuvitus: talvi-ilta kotona. Ikkunan alla: Illustration: a winter evening at home. A district heating radiator under the window heats the room, and warm air rises above the radiator. It is snowing outside.
Pylväskuvaaja mittakaavassa: lauhdevoima: Bar chart to scale: the power of a condensing power plant at the steps of the energy chain. The heights of the bars are P_0 = 400 MW (fuel), P_1 = 350 MW (after the boiler), P_2 = 150 MW (after the steam cycle) and P_3 = 140 MW (after the generator and transformer, that is electricity). The grid spacing is 50 MW.
Virtauskaavio (Sankey) lauhdevoimalaitok: Flow diagram (Sankey) of the energy chain of a condensing power plant. The fuel power of 500 MW flows from left to right as a band that narrows step by step. In the boiler 40 MW goes away with the flue gases, in the turbine and condenser 248 MW goes to the sea as heat, and in the generator and transformer 12 MW is lost. The electricity obtained is 200 MW, that is 40 per cent of the fuel power. The widths of the bands and arrows are to scale, 100 MW is 40 pixels.
